requirement.original: Fix all 5 remaining UI issues in the happy-app: Edit tool file content, AskUserQuestion answer persistence, subagent sidebar missing content, Bash truncation confirmation, detail page sidebar confirmation
requirement.clarified: Fix 3 active bugs (Edit tool sidebar lacks file content, AskUserQuestion answers lost on remount, subagent sidebar empty) and confirm 2 already-fixed issues (Bash 3-line truncation, detail page closes sidebar)
requirement.what: Three bug fixes across CLI and app, plus two confirmations

included: Issue 1: Inject file content into Edit tool-call-end output in CLI sessionProtocolMapper
Issue 2: Persist AskUserQuestion answers into tool.permission state in app
Issue 3: Fix subagent message sidechain population in reducer

success_criteria: Edit tool sidebar shows file content (not just old_string/new_string diff)
AskUserQuestion answers visible after navigating away and back
Subagent sidebar shows text messages and TodoWrite calls

File content must be size-capped to avoid bloating messages
Answer persistence must work for both fresh submission and session reload
All fixes must pass yarn typecheck

issues.title: Edit tool cannot show full file content in sidebar
issues.root_cause: sessionProtocolMapper.ts emits tool-call-end with output from extractToolResultOutput() which only contains the tool_result content string (typically empty or a short confirmation). The Edit tool's input only has file_path, old_string, new_string, replace_all. Neither source contains the full file content.
issues.fix_approach: In sessionProtocolMapper.ts, when processing a tool_result block where the corresponding tool_use was an Edit call, read the file at file_path using fs.readFileSync, and include the file content in the tool-call-end envelope's output field. This data flows to the app where SidebarFileView can display it.

fix_location.area: tool_result processing in assistant message handling (around the tool-call-end envelope creation)
fix_location.details: The mapper needs to track tool_use names/inputs so when the corresponding tool_result arrives, it knows the tool was Edit and can read file_path. Currently toolTitle() and toToolArgs() extract info from tool_use blocks. The tool-call-end is emitted at lines 741-746 (hidden parent) and 753-757 (normal). Both use extractToolResultOutput(block) for the output field.

implementation_notes: Need to maintain a map of tool_use_id -> {name, input} during assistant message processing
When emitting tool-call-end for an Edit tool, read file at input.file_path
Cap file read at 100KB to prevent message bloat
Handle missing files gracefully (file deleted between edit and result)
The output field is already a string, so file content can be injected directly or as JSON
Consider also handling Write tool the same way

issues.title: AskUserQuestion answers disappear on re-entry
issues.root_cause: When user submits answers in AskUserQuestionView, handleSubmit calls sessionAllow(sessionId, permissionId, ..., answers). This sends an RPC to CLI which resolves the permission with updatedInput containing answers. However, the answers are NEVER written back to the app's local state. The tool.permission object (typesMessage.ts:14-22) has no 'answers' field. On remount, AskUserQuestionView lines 271-273 check tool.result.answers and tool.permission.answers -- both are undefined because: (a) Claude SDK tool_result doesn't include the original answers, (b) permission object in agentState completedRequests doesn't include answers either.
issues.fix_approach: Two-part fix: (1) Add 'answers' field to the ToolCall.permission type in typesMessage.ts. (2) In ops.ts sessionAllow, after calling apiSocket.sessionRPC, also update the local sync state to store the answers in the permission object. The existing recovery code in AskUserQuestionView (line 272: tool.permission.answers) will then work.

fix_location.details: Add 'answers?: Record<string, string>' to the permission type

fix_location_2.details: After the RPC call, update the tool's permission in local state with the answers record

implementation_notes: typesMessage.ts ToolCall.permission needs: answers?: Record<string, string>
ops.ts sessionAllow needs to write answers into local sync state BEFORE or alongside the RPC
The reducer's Phase 0 completedRequests processing (reducer.ts ~474-637) should also pass through answers if they exist in agentState
permissionHandler.ts line 123-137 already handles AskUserQuestion answers correctly on CLI side
permissionHandler.ts line 67-79 advertises askUserQuestionAnswersInPermission capability
The CLI stores answers in completedRequests agentState but only stores status/reason/mode/allowedTools -- NOT answers. This is the server-side gap.
Quick fix: persist locally in app state. Better fix: also store in agentState completedRequests on CLI side.

issues.title: Subagent TodoWrite/text missing in sidebar
issues.root_cause: The SidebarAgentConversation component correctly renders all 4 message kinds (agent-text, tool-call, agent-event, user-text). The issue is upstream: the reducer's sidechain map (state.sidechains) may not contain the subagent's internal messages. The flow is: (1) CLI sessionProtocolMapper emits envelopes with subagent field, (2) app normalizer converts to NormalizedMessage with isSidechain flag, (3) reducerTracer traces and assigns sidechainId, (4) reducer Phase 4 processes sidechain messages into state.sidechains map. The gap is likely in step 3: the tracer matches sidechain roots by prompt text (promptToTaskId map), and child messages by parentUUID inheritance. If subagent internal messages (text, TodoWrite tool calls) don't carry the correct parentUUID or isSidechain flag, they fall through as non-sidechain messages and never appear in the sidechain array.
issues.fix_approach: Investigate the exact data flow: check what envelopes the CLI mapper emits for subagent text and tool calls, verify the normalizer sets isSidechain correctly, and verify the tracer assigns correct sidechainId. The most likely fix is in the CLI mapper ensuring all subagent envelopes carry the subagent field, or in the tracer/reducer ensuring messages with subagent field are treated as sidechain messages.

fix_location.area: Subagent message handling (lines ~496-571, assistant message processing with subagent field)
fix_location.details: Verify that text blocks and tool_use blocks within subagent context carry the subagent field in the envelope

fix_location_2.details: Verify that messages with subagent field but no explicit isSidechain are properly traced

implementation_notes: sessionProtocolMapper.ts line 502: text envelopes include { turn: turnId, subagent } -- this looks correct
sessionProtocolMapper.ts lines 551-558: tool-call-start includes { turn: turnId, subagent } -- also correct
The normalizer (typesRaw.ts) must set isSidechain based on the envelope's subagent field
reducerTracer.ts matches sidechain roots by prompt (line 235-239) and children by parentUUID (line 259-296)
If the normalizer doesn't set isSidechain for subagent messages, they are filtered into nonSidechainMessages and processed as main-conversation messages instead of sidechain messages
Need to verify the normalizer code to confirm this hypothesis
SidebarAgentConversation.tsx itself is correct -- all 4 ChildMessageBlock cases handle rendering properly

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Three UI data gaps: Edit tool sidebar shows only diff, AskUserQuestion answers lost on remount, subagent sidebar empty
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Data flow gaps at three different layers: (1) CLI mapper doesn't inject file content into Edit tool-call-end output, (2) app never persists AskUserQuestion answers to local state after RPC, (3) subagent sidechain messages may not be properly traced/populated in reducer
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Each feature was implemented with forward-only data flow without considering the return/persistence path
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Users see incomplete information in sidebar views and lose interactive state
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Present since initial implementation of each feature
